Long, flowing platinum-white hair with straight-cut bangs. Wide, almond-shaped amethyst-purple eyes. Apparent age is early twenties with a serene, youthful face. Slender, graceful build. Wears a white and gold flowing gown with translucent silk sleeves and a gold filigree bodice. A gold circlet rests upon the brow.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
